examples.q: Benjamin Franklin's father made candles in Boston from one particular material. According to Faraday's candle lectures, what is that material made from, and how can it be turned into stearin?
examples.expected: Franklin's father was a tallow-chandler, so the material is tallow. Faraday says it is suet, the fat of the ox (Russian tallow). To make stearin it is boiled with quick-lime into a soap, the soap is decomposed with sulphuric acid (leaving stearic acid and giving glycerin), and the oil is pressed out.

hybrid.answer: Faraday says Benjamin Franklin's father made candles of tallow, and tallow is made from the suet—the fat of the ox (Russian tallow)—as described in the candle lecture on the flame's sources. It can be turned into stearin through the work of Gay Lussac (or someone entrusted with his knowledge), who converted the suet/tallow into that beautiful substance, stearin.

hr.answer: The material is tallow, which Faraday identifies as the fat of the ox (suet) [1]. It can be converted into stearin by the process Gay Lussac's knowledge made possible [1]: the fat or tallow is first boiled with quick-lime and made into a soap, then the soap is decomposed by sulphuric acid, which takes away the lime and leaves the fat re-arranged as stearic acid, while glycerin is produced at the same time [3]. The oil is then pressed out, with impurities carried away by the oily part as pressure increases, leaving the substance that is melted and cast into candles [3].

lex5b.answer: Franklin's father made candles from tallow. According to Faraday, tallow is the suet, or fat of the ox (Russian tallow, in the dips he showed). To convert it into stearin, the fat or tallow is first boiled with quick-lime to make a soap, which is then decomposed by sulphuric acid; the acid removes the lime, leaving the fat re-arranged as stearic acid, with glycerin produced at the same time. The oil is then pressed out, and the remaining substance is melted and cast into candles.

s2_hr.fa: بازرتبه‌ساز cross-encoder نامزدها را از نو مرتب می‌کند.

s2_lex.fa: فراخوانی گزینش بخش‌هایی را که به پرسش پاسخ می‌دهند برمی‌گزیند و آن‌ها را در صدر می‌گذارد.

s3.en: The pack takes candidates in order until 6,000 characters are used: {n} passages, {chars} characters.
s3.fa: بسته نامزدها را به ترتیب برمی‌دارد تا ظرفیت ۶٬۰۰۰ کاراکتری‌اش پر شود: {n} بخش، {chars} کاراکتر.

s4_ok.fa: مدل پاسخ‌گو از روی بسته پاسخ می‌دهد. داور: درست.

s4_no.en: The reader answers from the pack. Judged wrong.
s4_no.fa: مدل پاسخ‌گو از روی بسته پاسخ می‌دهد. داور: نادرست.

full_yes.fa: همهٔ شواهد مرجع به مدل پاسخ‌گو رسید.

full_no.en: Part of the gold evidence did not reach the reader.
